name: vid_ref_seg_benchmark
description: A video referring segmentation benchmark that measures a model's ability to localize and segment an object in video given a natural language referring expression. It evaluates temporal consistency and per-frame segmentation quality across short video clips. Designed to test multimodal understanding of language grounded in visual video data.
reputation: Niche research benchmark for video referring segmentation with limited but growing use in multimodal vision-language research.
